verified_method_facts: A normalizing flow estimates whether the current state belongs to situations anticipated by the learning-based method.
The estimated state likelihood drives online switching between learning-based and rule-based navigation methods.
The paper reports simulation and real-world experiments.
The reference list includes Graph Normalizing Flows, RealNVP, and GATv2.
unverified_details: switch frequency, hysteresis, and hold logic
claim_boundary: The local baseline tests whether nominal-state likelihood switching can explain PIRoute's gains under the same frozen Actors and scenarios. It is not the authors' implementation and does not reproduce the original learning/rule-based system.
